description: When I am governor, teachers will have my respect and support. Weirdly, Gov. Little claimed the same thing in his “teacher appreciation week” message—not long after he earned a  no-confidence vote from teachers for attacking the Idaho Education Association (IEA). I love teachers. The IEA
